metadata.question: Did lake ice extent on Lake Winnipeg, Canada, decrease between May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Winnipeg, Canada (approximately 49.7°N, 97.3°W) - Dates: May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021 (spring, ice extent should be minimal/decreasing) - Collection: Sentinel-2 (10m resolution, good for ice detection) or Landsat 8 (30m resolution) - Need to compare ice extent between two dates 2. Masking strategy: - Use NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) or blue/red bands to detect ice - NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) or use simple reflectance-based method - Mask clouds to get valid observations - Alternative: Use Surface Reflectance data which has cloud masking built-in 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check if we have valid images for both dates (C1 if not) - Check if we have valid pixels after cloud masking (C2 if not) - Calculate ice extent (pixels with NDSI > threshold, or high blue/low red reflectance) - Compare extent: if extent on May 19 < extent on May 7, answer is A (Yes, decreased) - If extent on May 19 >= extent on May 7, answer is B (No, did not decrease) - Handle NaN/None results as C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Lake Winnipeg geometry const lakeWinnipeg = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-101.5, 50.5], [-95.0, 50.5], [-95.0, 49.0], [-101.5, 49.0], [-101.5, 50.5]] ]); // Define dates const date1 = '2021-05-07'; const date2 = '2021-05-19'; // Sentinel-2 collection with cloud masking const s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeWinnipeg) .filterDate(date1, '2021-05-08') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const s2_2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeWinnipeg) .filterDate(date2, '2021-05-20') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const count1 = s2.size().getInfo(); const count2 = s2_2.size().getInfo(); print(`May 7, 2021 Images: ${count1}`); print(`May 19, 2021 Images: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { print('Insufficient data for one or both dates'); print('C1'); return; } // Use median composite for each date const img1 = s2.median(); const img2 = s2_2.median(); // Calculate NDSI for ice detection: (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) // Sentinel-2: B3=Green(560nm), B11=SWIR(1610nm) const ndsi1 = img1.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('ndsi'); const ndsi2 = img2.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('ndsi'); // Ice threshold (NDSI > 0.4 indicates ice/snow) const iceThreshold = 0.4; const ice1 = ndsi1.gt(iceThreshold); const ice2 = ndsi2.gt(iceThreshold); // Count ice pixels const iceCount1 = ice1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeWinnipeg, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ndsi').getInfo(); const iceCount2 = ice2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeWinnipeg, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('ndsi').getInfo(); print(`May 7 Ice Pixels: ${iceCount1}`); print(`May 19 Ice Pixels: ${iceCount2}`); if (iceCount1 === null || iceCount2 === null || iceCount1 === 0 && iceCount2 === 0) { print('No valid ice data after processing'); print('C2'); return; } // Calculate percentage change const percentChange = ((iceCount2 - iceCount1) / iceCount1 * 100); print(`Ice Extent Change: ${percentChange.toFixed(1)}%`); // Determine answer if (iceCount2 < iceCount1) { print('Ice extent decreased between May 7 and May 19, 2021'); print('A'); } else { print('Ice extent did not decrease'); print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
